title: Contract Expiry Notices and Holdover Service - C&I Terms
content:
## Expiry notice and holdover (Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts)

1. An expiry notice is compliant when its notice date falls no earlier than the earliest and no later than the latest expiry notice days before the contract end date: no earlier than 120 and no later than 60 calendar days before it, on every Beacon Ridge C&I structure.
2. Expiry notices are issued only on an active contract.
3. When the term reaches the contract end date without a signed renewal and without a termination in progress, the contract moves to holdover on the following day, recorded as the holdover start date.
4. Holdover energy is priced as the structure's holdover pricing provides (the real-time index plus the holdover adder); holdover can be ended on the structure's holdover termination notice; and ending holdover carries no early termination fee where the structure applies none, which is the case on all six structures.

## Compliance boundary (hypothetical contract end date 30 June 2026)

| Notice date | Calendar days before the contract end date | Compliant |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March 2026 | 121 | no, too early |
| 2 March 2026 | 120 | yes |
| 1 May 2026 | 60 | yes |
| 2 May 2026 | 59 | no, too late |
| no notice issued | none | no |

## Moving to holdover

| Position on the contract end date | Result the following day |
|---|---|
| no signed renewal and no termination in progress | holdover begins; the holdover start date is the day after the contract end date |
| a renewal signed | this clause does not move the contract to holdover |
| a termination in progress | this clause does not move the contract to holdover |

## Status check

An expiry notice is not issued on a contract that is pending enrollment, termination pending, in holdover, closed or rejected.
